messages:
ida: Hey folks — PR #55880 updates the routing fallback to prefer a lower-cost model when latency > 180ms. Touches auth header ordering and routing table. Need runtime + security eyes and someone to own the canary/merge slot tomorrow morning. Short summary + PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/55880
sam: I can take runtime review but I'm out 06:00-10:00 UTC tomorrow. Can you paste the risky diff or a quick summary of regressions?
ida: Sure — diff snippet:
```
- headers = sorted(req.headers)
+ headers = prioritize_auth(req.headers)
```
No token copies introduced. Also added a brief runbook and perf snapshot to the PR (see the Checks tab).
marta: cc @marta-security — I will review for auth header reorder risk. At first glance looks low-risk, but if proxies change behavior we should validate header forwarding in the integration test.
chao: FYI routing fallback may route some traffic to hosted tier under load. @alex can you sanity-check capacity + eviction effects?
alex: I'll run the eviction/cold-start sim and check p99 impact. Any spike on cold-starts reported in the perf snapshot? If fallback causes higher sustained p99 we might need a temporary autoscale bump.
deploy-bot: merge-queue: PR #55880 — CI: ✅ passed. Canary scheduled for 2026-01-05 09:00 UTC. Will hold if requested.
sam: I'll run a runtime perf pass tonight (microbench + ~1k req sample) and post numbers here. Please hold the canary until security signs off and I confirm perf. :thumbsup:
marta: If runtime is green and infra confirms no regressions, I can sign off by 08:30 UTC tomorrow.
ida: Thanks all — holding the merge slot. @sam ping me when you post the numbers and @alex please drop results in this thread.
